options_evaluated: Virgin ABS with overmolded TPE grips
Bio-based polyamide composite with fiberglass reinforcement
assessments.rationale: Using PCR PP monomaterial maximizes the use of recycled materials (h) and significantly reduces the material footprint (o) compared to virgin plastics. Eliminating overmolded TPE ensures a clean single-polymer stream, which directly optimizes the design for recycling (d). Additionally, PP has a lower density than ABS, supporting lightweight design (t) and reducing the overall weight of the product (j).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (PCR PP has lower scratch resistance and tensile strength than virgin ABS, potentially reducing cosmetic durability and product lifespan) and Manufacturing (PCR resins can exhibit higher shrinkage variation, requiring tighter process controls and potentially increasing tooling reject rates).
espr_parameters: (h) use or content of recycled materials
(j) weight and volume of the product and its packaging

options_evaluated: Ultrasonic welding and permanent chemical adhesives
Reversible snap-fits and standardized non-magnetic metal screws
assessments.recommendation: Reversible snap-fits and standardized non-magnetic metal screws
assessments.rationale: This method avoids permanent adhesives that act as contaminants in recycling processes, thereby enhancing design for recycling (d). It allows non-destructive disassembly, facilitating the recovery and incorporation of used components (k) and reducing the overall material footprint (o) of the product lifecycle.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (increased assembly time, higher labor costs, and more parts to manage compared to automated ultrasonic welding) and Use Phase (potential for air leaks at joints over time, which reduces suction efficiency, or risk of users opening electrical enclosures and compromising safety).

options_evaluated: Standard brushed DC motor with heavy copper windings
High-efficiency brushless DC (BLDC) motor with virgin neodymium magnets
Synchronous reluctance motor without rare-earth magnets and with demountable windings
assessments.recommendation: Synchronous reluctance motor without rare-earth magnets and with demountable windings
assessments.rationale: This technology eliminates the use of substances of concern (f) and critical raw materials (rare-earth magnets), which significantly lowers the environmental footprint (m) and material footprint (o) associated with destructive mining. Demountable windings ensure that copper and steel can be easily separated, optimizing the design for recycling (d).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (synchronous reluctance motors are generally larger and heavier for the same power output, which conflicts with lightweight design (t) and may increase energy consumption during use compared to high-energy-density BLDC motors).

options_evaluated: Active cooling with auxiliary fan and heavy aluminum heatsinks
Passive cooling via optimized airflow channels and bio-based thermal conductive plastics
Liquid cooling loop with copper piping and synthetic coolants
assessments.recommendation: Passive cooling via optimized airflow channels and bio-based thermal conductive plastics
assessments.rationale: Utilizing bio-based thermal conductive plastics incorporates sustainable renewable materials (i) and reduces the environmental footprint (m) of raw material sourcing. Eliminating heavy metal heatsinks and auxiliary fans supports lightweight design (t) and minimizes the weight and volume of the product (j).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (passive cooling may lead to higher internal operating temperatures, which can accelerate the thermal degradation of electronics and batteries, potentially shortening the product's useful service life).
espr_parameters: (i) use or content of sustainable renewable materials
(j) weight and volume of the product and its packaging

options_evaluated: Monolithic integrated chassis with potted electronics
Modular architecture with easily separable functional blocks (motor, battery, filtration, cord)
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections
assessments.recommendation: Modular architecture with easily separable functional blocks (motor, battery, filtration, cord)
assessments.rationale: A modular architecture enables the easy extraction and incorporation of used components (k) during refurbishment. It allows users or recyclers to cleanly isolate different material streams (e.g., batteries, electronics, plastics), which directly supports design for recycling (d) and reduces the material footprint (o) by preventing premature disposal of the entire machine.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Packaging and Distribution (modular designs often require additional internal structural walls and connectors, which increases the overall weight and volume of the product and its packaging (j), leading to lower shipping efficiency).
espr_parameters: (j) weight and volume of the product and its packaging

options_evaluated: Mains-powered with an automatic cord reel
Removable and modular Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) battery pack
assessments.recommendation: Removable and modular Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) battery pack
assessments.rationale: An LFP chemistry avoids substances of concern (f) like cobalt and nickel, reducing the environmental footprint (m). Making the pack removable and modular ensures it can be easily detached for recycling (d) or replaced with used/refurbished cells, promoting the incorporation of used components (k) and reducing the material footprint (o).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use Phase (LFP batteries have lower energy density compared to standard Li-ion, which increases the weight (t) of the vacuum and reduces operating run-time, potentially degrading user experience) and Manufacturing (sourcing high-quality recycled LFP cells at scale can be challenging).
